one_line: Founder of the Pala dynasty, stabilising Varendra and Magadha in the mid-8th century CE.

appearance.age_look: Late 30s to early 40s, medium-tall, sturdy and broad-shouldered with the solid build of a battle-tested ruler.
appearance.face: Oval face with a strong jaw, warm medium-brown complexion, straight nose, thick slightly arched brows, and calm, observant eyes; neatly trimmed moustache with a short close beard framing the chin; default expression is steady and composed with a hint of quiet resolve.
appearance.hair: Dark black hair gathered into a high, neat topknot at the back of the crown, the rest smoothed back; a simple narrow gold circlet rests low on the forehead, with a small central oval red stone, and no extravagant plume.
appearance.costume: He wears an 8th-century eastern Indian kshatriya ensemble: a long-sleeved, mid-thigh-length cotton tunic in deep indigo blue with a subtle woven check pattern, side-slit at the hips for movement, belted with a broad leather girdle dyed dark brown and fitted with a simple rectangular bronze clasp; below, he has a finely wrapped off-white cotton dhoti tied at the waist, pleats brought forward and tucked, reaching the ankles, with a narrow red border; across his torso is a diagonally draped, soft, unpatterned ochre-orange uttariya (shawl), starting from his left shoulder and passing under the right arm, its edge sometimes gathered in his left hand; his forearms are protected by plain brown leather bracers, and on his feet are sturdy, closed leather sandals with a strap over the instep suited to marching; jewellery is modest—short gold stud earrings, a single medium-thick gold neck torque, and two simple gold bangles on his right wrist—evoking status without ostentation.
appearance.signature: A straight, single-edged iron sword with a slightly widening tip in a plain brown leather scabbard; the hilt has a simple crossguard and a rounded wooden grip wrapped in dark cord, worn suspended from his belt on his left hip, his right hand often resting on the pommel.

ref_desc: Gopala I is a medium-brown, strong-jawed man in his late 30s with a neat moustache and short beard, black hair in a high topknot under a simple gold circlet, wearing a deep indigo tunic, off-white dhoti, ochre uttariya, brown leather belt and bracers, gold jewellery, and carrying a plain-hilted straight sword in a brown scabbard at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character model of Gopala I: a sturdy, broad-shouldered man in his late 30s with a warm medium-brown complexion, oval face, strong jaw, calm serious eyes, thick brows, a neatly trimmed moustache and short chin beard, and dark black hair pulled into a high topknot with the rest smoothed back. On his forehead sits a narrow gold circlet with a small central red stone, and he wears short gold stud earrings, a single medium-thick gold neck torque, and two simple gold bangles on his right wrist. His costume is an 8th-century eastern Indian warrior-ruler outfit: a long-sleeved, mid-thigh indigo blue cotton tunic with a subtle woven check texture and side slits at the hips, belted with a broad dark brown leather girdle and simple bronze buckle; a finely wrapped off-white cotton dhoti with a narrow red border reaches his ankles; an ochre-orange uttariya (shawl) is draped diagonally from his left shoulder across his chest and under his right arm, hanging in soft folds. His forearms are fitted with plain brown leather bracers, and his feet are in sturdy closed brown leather sandals with an instep strap. At his left hip hangs his signature weapon: a straight, single-edged iron sword in a plain brown leather scabbard, with a simple crossguard and rounded wooden grip wrapped in dark cord, his right hand often resting lightly on the pommel. Use a palette dominated by deep indigo blue, off-white, ochre orange, dark brown, and gold, and present him in neutral, front, and side poses to clearly show hair, face, clothing details, and the sword placement.
